verdict.rationale: uv installs Python packages via wheels (prebuilt binaries) by default and uses a global cache to avoid re-downloading/re-building dependencies already fetched, with docs confirming aggressive caching and disk-efficient global cache for deduplication; community reports corroborate the speed gains from this caching. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation contrasting wheel vs sdist source builds, and independent benchmarking specifically isolating binary-cache reuse rather than general speed.
